call_points.text: Passive QAAUM (ETFs & Index) demonstrated strong momentum, expanding 15.61% YoY to ₹1,87,807 Cr with 12.66% market share.
Group AUM declined YoY due to EPFO's February 2026 reallocation after expanding its fixed income mandate from two to four managers.
UTI Pension Fund Ltd AUM grew 10.97% YoY to ₹4,31,769 Cr, maintaining a 24.01% market share in the NPS industry.
Gross SIP inflows ₹2,502 Cr; SIP AUM rose 8.05% YoY to ₹45,595 Cr.
Equity flow market share is well below stock share; management pins the fix on better scheme performance.
Flexi cap saw redemption pressure; large & mid cap and pure mid cap had positive net sales.
No buyback on the table; management keeps cash for bolt-on acquisitions in AMC, alternatives or international.
Final dividend of ₹40 per share approved at the 21 July 2026 AGM, a 95% pay-out ratio.
Pension fund headcount to more than double over 18 months, mostly relationship managers and sales roles.
International flows negative for about two years on weak appetite for India and the flagship scheme's performance; management calls it cyclical.
Regulatory approval received for UTI Nifty 500 ETF and index fund and UTI BSE Index Sector Leaders ETF; more products in pipeline.
Yield on equity and hybrid funds about 72-73 bps; ETF and index about 8 bps; fixed income about 20 bps.
Management's primary strategic focus for FY27 is accelerating growth across all business lines to leverage built-in operating leverage.

operating_notes.text: UTI Group total AUM stood at ₹23.42 lakh crores as of March 31, 2026.
UTI Mutual Fund launched 'Wealth 360' digital feature on the UTI MF App and website in partnership with Finarkein.
Equity and hybrid fund yields were about 72-73 bps, ETF and index about 8 bps, cash and arbitrage about 12 bps and fixed income about 20 bps in Q1FY27.
UTI International AUM was about USD 1.48 billion (₹14,027 Cr) as of 30 June 2026, with clients across more than 30 countries.
UTI SDOF IV, planned as a ₹1,500 Cr fund with a ₹500 Cr greenshoe, had AUM of about ₹887 Cr as of 30 June 2026.
UTI AMC domestic mutual fund QAAUM reached ₹4,02,337 Cr in Q2 FY27 with market share of 4.61%.
UTI Pension Fund Ltd managed ₹4,31,769 Cr in AUM as of September 2026, holding a 24.01% NPS market share.
Consolidated total investment book was ₹4,329 Cr as on 30 September 2026, comprising 67% debt/liquid, 23% equity, and 10% hybrid.

timeline.summary: UTI AMC reported FY26 consolidated AUM of ₹23.42 lakh crore and proposed a final dividend of ₹40 per share.
UTI Asset Management Company Limited shared the earnings conference call recording for Q4FY26 and FY26 on 23rd April 2026 at 1800 hrs IST via its website.
On April 28, 2026, UTI Asset Management Company filed the earnings call transcript for Q4 and FY26, reporting total AUM of ₹23.42 lakh crore and proposing a ₹40 per share dividend.
On May 25, 2026, UTI Mutual Fund announced the launch of Wealth 360, a digital wealth tracking feature built on the Account Aggregator framework.
Life Insurance Corporation of India (HR G AH, S. K. Srivastava, Executive Director) declared no new encumbrances on UTI Asset Management shares by 2nd April 2026.

On 23 July 2026 UTI AMC's Q1FY27 call reported consolidated core revenue flat at ₹379 Cr and core PAT up 6% YoY to ₹129 Cr, with management flagging weak investment performance and no buyback on the table.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹414.59 Cr (-0.9% YoY), net profit ₹132.31 Cr (+0.1% YoY).
UTI AMC released its revised Q2 FY27 investor presentation, reporting consolidated core PAT up 22% YoY to ₹131 Cr and total Group AUM of ₹16.28 lakh Cr.
